PX-C1.name: Noetherian power series, Nakayama, exact finite completion and weak Nullstellensatz
PX-C1.statement_used: Finite formal power series over a Noetherian ring are Noetherian; Nakayama for finite modules; I-adic completion is exact on finite modules over a Noetherian ring; maximal residue fields of a finite-type algebra over algebraically closed K equal K.
PX-C1.matching: PX1 proves the finite-monomial reduction. PX2 proves the required cofinal invariant topology and recursive equivariant formal inverse. PX4 constructs a nonzero finite-type fibre by an explicit Reynolds retraction. Only the stated elementary completion and residue-field leaves are cited.

PX-C2.name: Finite local fields and the absence of everywhere-unramified extensions of Q
PX-C2.statement_used: The valuation on a finite extension of a complete discretely valued field is unique and its nonnegative elements are integral; Q has no nontrivial everywhere-unramified finite extension (Minkowski).
PX-C2.matching: Used after finite coefficient capture or on an individual algebraic element. PX3/PX7 pass through actual finite quotients of compact characters; no blanket assertion that a compact subset of Qbar_l is in a finite field is used.

PX-C3.kind: matched classical arithmetic leaf supplied through DX1
PX-C3.name: Finite local Tate duality and local Euler at p distinct from ell
PX-C3.statement_used: For finite residual modules at the actual decomposition group, h2(M)=h0(M-dual(1)) and h0-h1+h2=0 at p distinct from ell.
PX-C3.supplier: DX1, with original-place transport and exact cup-product normalization
PX-C3.matching: PX6 locVanP proves both invariant spaces vanish using the same sigma_p, residual cyclotomic value1 and actual root-character separation; this implies every local residual cocycle is a coboundary. No BlochKatoLocal input is used.
